question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing center midfielder, Bob is playing goalkeeper, Claire is playing fullback, Dave is playing left winger, and Eve is playing right back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Finally, Alice and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) center midfielder
(B) goalkeeper
(C) fullback
(D) left winger
(E) right back
solution:
Positions in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve):
Initial: (center midfielder, goalkeeper, fullback, left winger, right back)
1. Eve ↔ Dave: (center midfielder, goalkeeper, fullback, right back, left winger)
2. Dave ↔ Eve: (center midfielder, goalkeeper, fullback, left winger, right back)
3. Dave ↔ Eve: (center midfielder, goalkeeper, fullback, right back, left winger)
4. Dave ↔ Claire: (center midfielder, goalkeeper, right back, fullback, left winger)
5. Alice ↔ Claire: (right back, goalkeeper, center midfielder, fullback, left winger)
Bob is playing goalkeeper, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
